algorithm: Drop ids in the committed pilot draw. For a memory category, keep the notetaker scenario only. random.Random('clean-start-usx-validation:{seed}:{category}').sample(sorted(remaining ids), k) when k is smaller than that list; otherwise keep the sorted list and do not sample. Python 3.12 random.
memory_scenario_reason: notetaker has the fewest prerequisite user-turns of the five scenarios (24, against 35 to 109). Matched prerequisites are per scenario, so the scenario is the memory bill. Chosen from the catalogue's turn counts, not from flight scores.

omitted_categories.reason: every in-scope id is in the exposed pilot draw
